# CommandButton

Run a command with its admission and action state.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components/command-button


Put the component inside [DataProvider](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/with-data). Pass a command description, not a fetch callback.

### Preview: CommandButton

Run a Data command with shared admission and progress. The example uses the public package component. Reset restores its initial state.


```tsx
import { CommandButton } from "@hyecompany/vem-ui/data";
import { tasks } from "./data-model.js";

export function CompleteTaskButton({ id }: { id: string }) {
	return (
		<CommandButton command={tasks.commands.complete({ id })}>
			Complete task
		</CommandButton>
	);
}
```


The button explains unavailable admission and observes the last action it started. While that action is running it prevents a duplicate activation. The server can still reject an admitted attempt.

Use `onAction` when the page also needs the immediate action handle for [inline feedback](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components/activity-feedback). The handle represents the shared action; it is not a second operation registry. Other Button props, including `variant` and `size`, still apply.

A retry is a separate deliberate operation. This button never resubmits an uncertain action automatically.

[API reference](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/data.Function.CommandButton) · [All props](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/data.Interface.CommandButtonProps)

# QueryStatus

Explain acquisition without hiding information already available.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components/query-status


Render the rows you have, then place QueryStatus beside them. It distinguishes missing information, failed acquisition, revalidation, and a proven-empty result.

### Preview: QueryStatus

Explain partial results, acquisition, and retry. The example uses the public package component. Reset restores its initial state.


```tsx
import { useQuery } from "@hyecompany/vem-data/react";
import { QueryStatus } from "@hyecompany/vem-ui/data";
import { tasks } from "./data-model.js";

export function TaskNames() {
	const result = useQuery(tasks.list({ select: ["title"] }));
	return (
		<>
			<ul>
				{result.rows.map((row) => (
					<li key={row.key}>{row.data.title ?? "Title unavailable"}</li>
				))}
			</ul>
			<QueryStatus result={result} empty="No tasks yet." />
		</>
	);
}
```


Customize `empty` and `loading` for the screen. An issue offers the result's retry when acquisition is idle. Retry acquires unsuccessful information; it is not a refresh policy.

QueryStatus does not turn unresolved filter candidates into matches or fill in absent fields. Your row rendering still chooses how to show missing selected values. See [partial results](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/build/partial-results).

[API reference](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/data.Function.QueryStatus) · [All props](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/data.Interface.QueryStatusProps)


---

# ActivityFeedback

Present progress and outcomes supported by action evidence.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components/activity-feedback


Pass a query description or the IDs of actions the page presents. ActivityFeedback observes their shared state and owns the inline feedback claim for as long as it is visible.

### Preview: ActivityFeedback

Show evidence-supported action progress and outcomes. The example uses the public package component. Reset restores its initial state.


```tsx
import { ActivityFeedback } from "@hyecompany/vem-ui/data";

export function TaskProgress({ actionId }: { actionId: string }) {
	return <ActivityFeedback actionIds={[actionId]} label="Completing task" />;
}
```


With `query={description}`, the component follows activities related to that query and shares its demand with other consumers. With `actionIds`, it follows the named actions. Set `active={false}` for a hidden region to release its query demand and inline claim.

The component preserves succeeded, partially applied, failed, and unknown outcomes. Numeric progress is shown only when the action supplies a total. Label it with the operation the user understands.

Cancel and Retry follow the action’s admitted controls and use its shared identity automatically. Supply `onCancel` or `onRetry` only to add an application-specific step such as confirmation. Dismissing feedback, stopping observation, and canceling server work remain separate choices. An unknown result is not evidence that nothing happened.

[API reference](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/data.Function.ActivityFeedback) · [All props](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/data.TypeAlias.ActivityFeedbackProps)


---

# ActivityToasts

Show action feedback assigned to this tab without duplicating page progress.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components/activity-toasts


Mount one feedback host inside DataProvider and Toaster. It presents feedback assigned by the client's feedback capability and removes information that is no longer disclosed.

### Preview: ActivityToasts

Present Data feedback assigned to this tab. The example uses the public package component. Reset restores its initial state.


```tsx
import { createToastManager, Toaster } from "@hyecompany/vem-ui";
import { ActivityToasts } from "@hyecompany/vem-ui/data";
import { type ReactNode, useState } from "react";

export function FeedbackHost({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
	const [manager] = useState(() => createToastManager());
	return (
		<Toaster toastManager={manager}>
			{children}
			<ActivityToasts />
		</Toaster>
	);
}
```


The browser client supplies its feedback capability automatically. An alternate client may pass `feedback` explicitly to DataProvider. Without that capability, this host has no assigned activities to show.

Visible pages use ActivityFeedback with a query or action IDs. Custom presentations can use `useInlineFeedback` directly. When they stop presenting an action, the owner's feedback policy can assign it to a toast. Closing a toast acknowledges the observed snapshot; it does not cancel work. Programmatic removal does not acknowledge an unseen outcome.

This preview supplies a deterministic feedback fixture. It demonstrates presentation and acknowledgement, not cross-tab ownership. See [feedback ownership](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect/feedback) for host behavior.

[API reference](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/data.Function.ActivityToasts) · [All props](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/data.Interface.ActivityToastsProps)


---

# Data bindings

Connect search, commands, and protected editing to ordinary controls.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components/data-bindings


Use `bindText` with a managed edit field and `bindCommand` with `useCommand`. Both return ordinary control props, so the application keeps its form layout.

### Preview: Data bindings

Connect an existing control to a command or protected field. The example uses the public package component. Reset restores its initial state.


```tsx
import { useCommand, useEdit } from "@hyecompany/vem-data/react";
import { Button, Textarea } from "@hyecompany/vem-ui";
import { bindCommand, bindText } from "@hyecompany/vem-ui/data";
import { useId } from "react";
import { tasks } from "./data-model.js";

export function ManagedNotes({ id }: { id: string }) {
	const label = useId();
	const edit = useEdit(tasks.edits.notes({ id }));
	const notes = edit.field("notes");
	return (
		<form
			onSubmit={(event) => {
				event.preventDefault();
				if (edit.canSave) edit.save();
			}}
		>
			<label htmlFor={label}>Notes</label>
			<Textarea id={label} {...bindText(notes)} />
			{notes.state !== "readable" && <p>{notes.reason}</p>}
			<Button type="submit" disabled={!edit.canSave}>
				Save notes
			</Button>
		</form>
	);
}

export function CompleteTask({ id }: { id: string }) {
	const command = useCommand(tasks.commands.complete({ id }));
	return <Button {...bindCommand(command)}>Complete task</Button>;
}
```


`bindText` derives its value directly from the edit session. If the field is unreadable, it becomes blank and disabled. A field can remain readable after write access is lost; its draft remains editable locally, while saving is disabled. `canEdit` describes local drafting; `canSave` describes admission of the server write. Show the field's reason when it is unavailable. Do not copy its value or default value into a separate state store.

`bindCommand` maps current admission to a native button. It does not observe action progress or prevent a second admitted operation. Use CommandButton when you want that coordination as part of the control. Availability's `reason` is also available to render beside a custom control; a `title` alone is insufficient for essential explanations.

For a complete editor with save outcomes and conflicts, continue to [protected editing](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/build/editors).

[API reference](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/data.Function.bindText)

[API reference](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/data.Function.bindCommand)

## Search shared information

`useSearch` keeps the typed text and passes it to a pure query factory. Its `result` is the ordinary query result, including partial rows, acquisition state, and retry. Vem evaluates the [predicate](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/build/display#filter-text) against shared knowledge and acquires missing information through the domain's sources.


```tsx
import { Input } from "@hyecompany/vem-ui";
import { QueryStatus, useSearch } from "@hyecompany/vem-ui/data";
import { useId } from "react";
import { tasks } from "./data-model.js";

export function TaskSearch() {
	const id = useId();
	const search = useSearch((text) =>
		tasks.list({
			select: ["title"],
			where: { title: { contains: text, case: "insensitive" } },
		}),
	);
	return (
		<section aria-label="Find a task">
			<label htmlFor={id}>Search tasks</label>
			<Input
				id={id}
				value={search.value}
				onChange={(event) => search.setValue(event.currentTarget.value)}
			/>
			<ul>
				{search.result.rows.map((row) => (
					<li key={row.key}>{row.data.title ?? "Title unavailable"}</li>
				))}
			</ul>
			<QueryStatus result={search.result} empty="No matching tasks." />
		</section>
	);
}
```


Use `{ enabled: open }` for a search panel that only needs data while open. Disabling releases its demand and returns no rows; the text remains until you call `setValue("")`. `{ acquire: false }` observes permitted cached information without creating acquisition demand. Neither option changes other consumers' requirements.

The input remains under your control: the hook adds no debounce, chooses no fields, and does not manage a selected option. Equivalent inline descriptions reuse Vem's existing query subscription.

[API reference](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/data.Function.useSearch)


---

# Branding and appearance

Use the same CSS theme as the rest of your application.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/customize


Vem UI uses ordinary shadcn theme variables. Its stylesheet includes defaults; existing application variables override them through the normal CSS cascade. No React theme provider is required.

### Preview: Appearance

A Button inherits primary color and radius from an ordinary CSS class. The example uses the public package component. Reset restores its initial state.


```tsx
import { Button } from "@hyecompany/vem-ui";

export function AppearanceExample() {
	return <Button className="weekend-action">Plan the weekend</Button>;
}
```


```css
.weekend-action {
  --primary: #315acb;
  --primary-foreground: #ffffff;
  --radius: 0.625rem;
}
```

## Match the whole application

Set semantic variables on `:root`, or on a containing element for a local variation. `--background` and `--foreground` describe the page; `--primary` and `--primary-foreground` style the main action. Related pairs cover `--secondary`, `--muted`, `--accent`, `--card`, and `--popover`. `--border`, `--input`, `--ring`, and `--destructive` cover outlines, focus, and errors. Sidebar colors use the usual `--sidebar-*` variables.

Use complete CSS color values, such as `oklch(...)`, `hsl(...)`, or hex colors. The package does not read `components.json` at runtime. Its components retain the shadcn API and semantic tokens, while their implementation and compiled CSS arrive through npm updates.

## Light, dark, and system themes

The default stylesheet follows the system color scheme. A document `.dark` or `.light` class can select a theme explicitly. Your application’s existing theme controller may set that class and its token values; Vem does not introduce another controller. CSS paints the theme before React hydrates.

Portals normally render beneath the document body and inherit the document theme. For a deliberately scoped theme, pass the themed element as a supported portal `container`, such as ComboboxContent’s `container`. CSS inheritance follows the actual DOM location.

## Local layout and composition

Use `className`, `style`, and the component’s ordinary props. Styled components accept a string `className`. Button’s `variant` and `size` choose its existing presentations. Use `render` where a component supports composing an existing link or trigger. Keep accessible labels, visible focus, and sufficient contrast when applying overrides.

Components ship compiled styles. Applications do not need Tailwind or source scanning. If you already use Tailwind, declare the layer order before importing styles so your utilities can override package defaults:

```css
@layer theme, base, vem, components, utilities;
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@hyecompany/vem-ui/styles.css";
```


---

# Use Vem UI with Data

Bind application state to controls while keeping data behavior in Vem Data.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/with-data


Core UI components work without Vem Data. When your application uses Data, `@hyecompany/vem-ui/data` connects the same controls to its public state.

Put the feature inside your existing DataProvider. Its resource definitions still decide what a task means, how to read it, and which commands are supported.

| Need | Use |
| --- | --- |
| Search shared information from a text field | [useSearch](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components/data-bindings#search-shared-information) |
| Show permitted rows with acquisition status | [QueryStatus](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components/query-status) |
| Admit a command and track its last action | [CommandButton](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components/command-button) |
| Render action progress on the page | [ActivityFeedback](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components/activity-feedback) |
| Move assigned feedback into notifications | [ActivityToasts](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components/activity-toasts) |
| Bind a custom control or protected field | [Data bindings](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components/data-bindings) |

The examples below these guides use this small resource contract. A host supplies its [domain implementation](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect).


```tsx
import {
	defineCommand,
	defineEdit,
	defineResource,
} from "@hyecompany/vem-data";

export const tasks = defineResource<
	{ title: string; notes: string },
	{ id: string }
>()({
	name: "tasks",
	fields: ["title", "notes"],
	commands: { complete: defineCommand() },
	edits: { notes: defineEdit<{ notes: string }>() },
});
```


These components present Data's result; they do not acquire independently, infer permissions, retry uncertain work, or copy drafts into an unrelated store.


---

# Reference

Public component, binding, and prop signatures.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference


[API signatures](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api) are generated from the public `@hyecompany/vem-ui` and `@hyecompany/vem-ui/data` entries. The [component catalog](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components) connects each entry to its usage guide and working preview.

Use React’s `ComponentProps<typeof Button>` (or the relevant component) when you need to reuse its prop type. The generated reference follows each component’s actual public signature.

Include `@hyecompany/vem-ui/styles.css` once. Importing JavaScript does not insert the stylesheet. The core entry has no Data dependency; the `/data` entry requires Vem Data and its provider.

Implementation changes belong in the package, with public prop documentation and compiled examples updated together. See [contributing to the docs](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/contributing) for the reference and snippet workflow.

# Task board

Vem Data and Vem UI working together in a small application.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/task-board


Find a task, complete it, and edit its notes. Each step starts with one thing to try; optional controls let you change the service's response or your permissions.

### Explore the task board

Vem UI controls and Vem Data power three short interactions: filtering, completing a task, and editing notes. Filtering and an overview share known task data. A command previews completion until its response is known. An edit keeps its draft when a teammate changes the saved note. Each lesson runs the real Vem runtime with a simulated in-page service. Source reads are simulated calls, not HTTP. The application has no SharedWorker or browser persistence.

## What belongs where?

**Vem UI** provides the buttons, tabs, fields, and task cards. **Vem Data** supplies queries, command progress, and protected edits. The application supplies the task layout and the meaning of its actions.

The task service runs in memory. For real network traffic and shared browser ownership, see [browser hosting](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect/browser-host).

[Build a screen](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/build/display) · [Use the components](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/components) · [Connect a backend](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect)

> **Where**\<`T`\> = `` { readonly [K in Exclude<keyof T & string, `$${string}`>]?: FieldCondition<T[K]> } `` & `object`

Fields are ANDed; $and and $or combine nested conditions without selecting their fields.

## Type Parameters

<a id="t"></a>

### T

`T` *extends* `object`

## Type Declaration

### $and?

> `readonly` `optional` **$and?**: readonly `Where`\<`T`\>[]

### $or?

> `readonly` `optional` **$or?**: readonly `Where`\<`T`\>[]

# Function: useQuery()

Generated from the public package entry points. Types and signatures follow the installed source.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/react.Function.useQuery

[**Vem Data API**](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api)

***


> **useQuery**\<`T`, `I`\>(`descriptor`, `__namedParameters?`): `object`

Subscribe to selected information. Equivalent inline descriptions share value-based identity; retry belongs to the returned result.

## Type Parameters

<a id="t"></a>

### T

`T` *extends* `object`

<a id="i"></a>

### I

`I`

## Parameters

### descriptor

[`QueryDescriptor`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.QueryDescriptor)\<`T`, `I`\>

### \_\_namedParameters?

[`UseQueryOptions`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/react.Interface.UseQueryOptions) = `{}`

## Returns

### activities

> **activities**: readonly [`ActionSnapshot`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.ActionSnapshot)\<[`ActionOutcome`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.TypeAlias.ActionOutcome)\<`unknown`, `unknown`\>\>[]

### confirmed

> **confirmed**: `object`

Coverage and count of confirmed matches, excluding proposal-only identities.

#### confirmed.complete

> **complete**: `boolean`

#### confirmed.knownCount

> **knownCount**: `number`

#### confirmed.total

> **total**: `number` \| `undefined`

### empty

> **empty**: `boolean`

True only when the result is established as empty; do not infer this from rows.length.

### exists

> **exists**: `boolean` \| `undefined`

Established detail presence or absence; undefined means unestablished.

### fetching

> **fetching**: `boolean`

Whether acquisition is outstanding; existing rows and unconfirmed candidates can remain visible.

### identityTransitions?

> `optional` **identityTransitions?**: readonly [`IdentityTransition`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.IdentityTransition)\<`I`\>[]

Explicit renames from this identity, including absent identities; follow only a previously selected incarnation.

### incarnation?

> `optional` **incarnation?**: `string`

Session-local identity incarnation for a detail result; a reused name has a different token.

### issues

> **issues**: readonly [`QueryIssue`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.QueryIssue)[]

### query

> **query**: [`QueryDescriptor`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.QueryDescriptor)\<`T`, `I`\> = `binding.query`

### retry

> **retry**: (() => `Promise`\<[`QueryResult`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.QueryResult)\<`T`, `I`\>\>) \| (() => `Promise`\<[`QueryResult`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.QueryResult)\<`T`, `I`\>\>) = `binding.handle.retry`

### revalidating

> **revalidating**: `boolean`

Whether running acquisition is checking this query's stale evidence; false while repair is stopped, failed, or only unrelated missing information is being acquired.

### revision

> **revision**: `number`

### rows

> **rows**: readonly [`QueryRow`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.TypeAlias.QueryRow)\<`T`, `I`\>[]

Established matches and visible proposals, including rows with missing display fields.

### settled

> **settled**: `boolean`

Whether the current attempt has settled, even if information remains partial or failed.

### stale

> **stale**: `boolean`

Whether permitted evidence needed by this query is known to need revalidation; missing information alone is not stale.

### unresolved

> **unresolved**: readonly [`QueryRow`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.TypeAlias.QueryRow)\<`T`, `I`\>[]

Candidates whose required filter or scope evidence is missing; do not present them as confirmed matches.


---

# Function: useReadStatus()

Generated from the public package entry points. Types and signatures follow the installed source.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/react.Function.useReadStatus

[**Vem Data API**](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api)

***


> **useReadStatus**\<`T`, `I`\>(`query`, `__namedParameters?`): `object`

Observe relevant reads across consumers without requesting data or grouping their queries.

## Type Parameters

<a id="t"></a>

### T

`T` *extends* `object`

<a id="i"></a>

### I

`I`

## Parameters

### query

[`QueryDescriptor`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.QueryDescriptor)\<`T`, `I`\>

### \_\_namedParameters?

[`UseReadStatusOptions`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/react.Interface.UseReadStatusOptions) = `{}`

## Returns

### canRetry

> **canRetry**: `boolean`

A matching unsuccessful active query can be retried. Retry restarts those queries, never the observer's broader selection.

### issues

> **issues**: readonly [`QueryIssue`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.QueryIssue)[]

Current failed or incomplete acquisition affecting matching active demands; withdrawn disclosure is excluded.

### pending

> **pending**: `boolean`

Relevant active demand is waiting for planning, queued, or running. Unknown offscreen information alone is not pending work.

### retry

> **retry**: (() => `Promise`\<`void`\>) \| (() => `Promise`\<`void`\>) = `handle.retry`

### revalidating

> **revalidating**: `boolean`

Relevant pending work is checking existing permitted stale evidence.

### acquire?

> `optional` **acquire?**: `boolean`

***

<a id="stacktracelimit"></a>

### stackTraceLimit

> `static` **stackTraceLimit**: `number`

The `Error.stackTraceLimit` property specifies the number of stack frames
collected by a stack trace (whether generated by `new Error().stack` or
`Error.captureStackTrace(obj)`).

The default value is `10` but may be set to any valid JavaScript number. Changes
will affect any stack trace captured _after_ the value has been changed.

If set to a non-number value, or set to a negative number, stack traces will
not capture any frames.

#### Inherited from

`Error.stackTraceLimit`

## Methods

<a id="capturestacktrace"></a>

### captureStackTrace()

> `static` **captureStackTrace**(`targetObject`, `constructorOpt?`): `void`

Creates a `.stack` property on `targetObject`, which when accessed returns
a string representing the location in the code at which
`Error.captureStackTrace()` was called.

```js
const myObject = {};
Error.captureStackTrace(myObject);
myObject.stack;  // Similar to `new Error().stack`
```

The first line of the trace will be prefixed with
`${myObject.name}: ${myObject.message}`.

The optional `constructorOpt` argument accepts a function. If given, all frames
above `constructorOpt`, including `constructorOpt`, will be omitted from the
generated stack trace.

The `constructorOpt` argument is useful for hiding implementation
details of error generation from the user. For instance:

```js
function a() {
  b();
}

function b() {
  c();
}

function c() {
  // Create an error without stack trace to avoid calculating the stack trace twice.
  const { stackTraceLimit } = Error;
  Error.stackTraceLimit = 0;
  const error = new Error();
  Error.stackTraceLimit = stackTraceLimit;

  // Capture the stack trace above function b
  Error.captureStackTrace(error, b); // Neither function c, nor b is included in the stack trace
  throw error;
}

a();
```

#### Parameters

##### targetObject

`object`

##### constructorOpt?

`Function`

#### Returns

`void`

#### Inherited from

`Error.captureStackTrace`

***

<a id="preparestacktrace"></a>

### prepareStackTrace()

> `static` **prepareStackTrace**(`err`, `stackTraces`): `any`

#### Parameters

##### err

`Error`

##### stackTraces

`CallSite`[]

#### Returns

`any`

#### See

https://v8.dev/docs/stack-trace-api#customizing-stack-traces

#### Inherited from

`Error.prepareStackTrace`

# Interface: AcquisitionSource

Generated from the public package entry points. Types and signatures follow the installed source.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.AcquisitionSource

[**Vem Data API**](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api)

***


Describes a backend read's capabilities, not a request plan. Only actual observations establish information or collection completeness.

## Properties

<a id="access"></a>

### access?

> `optional` **access?**: [`AccessRequirement`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.TypeAlias.AccessRequirement) \| ((`request`, `context`) => [`AccessRequirement`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.TypeAlias.AccessRequirement))

Request admission is separate from the disclosure bases carried by returned observations. Unknown permission permits an attempt by default.

***

<a id="accessunknown"></a>

### accessUnknown?

> `optional` **accessUnknown?**: `"attempt"` \| `"wait"` \| ((`request`, `context`) => `"attempt"` \| `"wait"`)

Unknown permission permits an attempt by default; a pure callback can wait for a separately discoverable authority prerequisite.

***

<a id="cost"></a>

### cost?

> `optional` **cost?**: `number` \| [`AcquisitionCost`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.AcquisitionCost) \| ((`request`, `context`) => `number` \| [`AcquisitionCost`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.AcquisitionCost))

Optional justified work estimate; all alternatives must use comparable units. Omit costs to use structural planning from observed population and demand.

***

<a id="fields"></a>

### fields

> **fields**: readonly `string`[]

***

<a id="filters"></a>

### filters?

> `optional` **filters?**: [`FilterCapabilities`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/index.Interface.FilterCapabilities) \| readonly `string`[]

Equality field shorthand or exact supported predicate capabilities; unsupported conditions remain local.

***

<a id="key"></a>

### key

> **key**: `string`

Stable source identifier, unique within its resource definition; consumers do not supply query cache keys.

***

<a id="membership"></a>

### membership?

> `optional` **membership?**: `boolean`

True when this list source can enumerate its collection. Partial responses must still report complete: false.

***

<a id="mode"></a>

### mode

> **mode**: `"one"` \| `"list"`

***

<a id="pagination"></a>

### pagination?

> `optional` **pagination?**: `object`

Bounded continuation controlled by Vem. Sources return AcquisitionPage instead of fetching subsequent pages themselves.

#### maxPages?

> `optional` **maxPages?**: `number`

#### pageSize

> **pageSize**: `number`

***

<a id="relationships"></a>

### relationships?

> `optional` **relationships?**: readonly `string`[]

***

<a id="select"></a>

### select?

> `optional` **select?**: `boolean`

True for field-selecting backends. Fixed representations (the default) can supply every declared field to later consumers.

# Interface: ActionHandle<Outcome>

Generated from the public package entry points. Types and signatures follow the installed source.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.ActionHandle

[**Vem Data API**](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api)

***


Immediate handle returned by run. Its result promise settles with the outcome; cancel, retry, and stopping observation have separate meanings.

# Interface: QueryResult<T, I>

Generated from the public package entry points. Types and signatures follow the installed source.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.QueryResult

[**Vem Data API**](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api)

***


An evidence-based read result. Established matches, unresolved candidates, confirmed coverage, and action proposals remain distinct; zero rows alone never proves emptiness.

## Type Parameters

<a id="t"></a>

### T

`T` *extends* `object` = [`Values`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.TypeAlias.Values)

<a id="i"></a>

`I` = [`Identity`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.TypeAlias.Identity)

## Properties

***

<a id="confirmed"></a>

### confirmed

> **confirmed**: `object`

Coverage and count of confirmed matches, excluding proposal-only identities.

#### complete

> **complete**: `boolean`

#### knownCount

> **knownCount**: `number`

#### total

> **total**: `number` \| `undefined`

***

<a id="empty"></a>

### empty

> **empty**: `boolean`

True only when the result is established as empty; do not infer this from rows.length.

***

<a id="exists"></a>

### exists

> **exists**: `boolean` \| `undefined`

Established detail presence or absence; undefined means unestablished.

***

<a id="fetching"></a>

### fetching

> **fetching**: `boolean`

Whether acquisition is outstanding; existing rows and unconfirmed candidates can remain visible.

***

<a id="identitytransitions"></a>

### identityTransitions?

> `optional` **identityTransitions?**: readonly [`IdentityTransition`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.IdentityTransition)\<`I`\>[]

Explicit renames from this identity, including absent identities; follow only a previously selected incarnation.

***

<a id="incarnation"></a>

### incarnation?

> `optional` **incarnation?**: `string`

Session-local identity incarnation for a detail result; a reused name has a different token.

***

<a id="issues"></a>

### issues

> **issues**: readonly [`QueryIssue`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.QueryIssue)[]

***

<a id="revalidating"></a>

### revalidating

> **revalidating**: `boolean`

Whether running acquisition is checking this query's stale evidence; false while repair is stopped, failed, or only unrelated missing information is being acquired.

***

<a id="revision"></a>

### revision

> **revision**: `number`

***

<a id="rows"></a>

### rows

> **rows**: readonly [`QueryRow`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.TypeAlias.QueryRow)\<`T`, `I`\>[]

Established matches and visible proposals, including rows with missing display fields.

***

<a id="settled"></a>

### settled

> **settled**: `boolean`

Whether the current attempt has settled, even if information remains partial or failed.

***

<a id="stale"></a>

### stale

> **stale**: `boolean`

Whether permitted evidence needed by this query is known to need revalidation; missing information alone is not stale.

***

<a id="unresolved"></a>

### unresolved

> **unresolved**: readonly [`QueryRow`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.TypeAlias.QueryRow)\<`T`, `I`\>[]

Candidates whose required filter or scope evidence is missing; do not present them as confirmed matches.


---

# Interface: ResourceContext

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.ResourceContext

[**Vem Data API**](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api)

***


An acquisition-fenced view of current knowledge and authority. Publish through this context so obsolete responses cannot revive withdrawn or superseded information.

## Extended by

- [`ActionContext`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.ActionContext)

## Properties

<a id="accesscontext"></a>

### accessContext

> `readonly` **accessContext**: `string`

***

<a id="acquisitionfence"></a>

### acquisitionFence

> `readonly` **acquisitionFence**: `string`

***

<a id="authorityfence"></a>

### authorityFence

> `readonly` **authorityFence**: `string`

Captured authority generations, independent of ordinary knowledge changes.

***

<a id="fetchpriority"></a>

### fetchPriority?

> `readonly` `optional` **fetchPriority?**: `"high"` \| `"auto"` \| `"low"`

Derived browser fetch hint for this acquisition; shared transports forward it without changing query identity.

***

<a id="signal"></a>

### signal

> `readonly` **signal**: `AbortSignal`

# Interface: ResourceDefinition

Generated from the public package entry points. Types and signatures follow the installed source.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.ResourceDefinition

[**Vem Data API**](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api)

***


Backend-specific evidence acquisition, extraction, derivation, commands, edits, and persistence allowances. Features depend on a resource contract rather than this owner definition.

## Extends

- [`ResourceReadDefinition`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.ResourceReadDefinition)

## Properties

<a id="access"></a>

### access?

> `optional` **access?**: [`AccessRequirement`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.TypeAlias.AccessRequirement) \| ((`query`) => [`AccessRequirement`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.TypeAlias.AccessRequirement))

A global read requirement, evaluated consistently in the owner and tab.

#### Inherited from

[`ResourceReadDefinition`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.ResourceReadDefinition).[`access`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.ResourceReadDefinition#access)

***

***

***

<a id="fieldaccess"></a>

### fieldAccess?

Per-field disclosure and read admission. A denied field does not prevent acquiring independently readable fields.

#### Inherited from

[`ResourceReadDefinition`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.ResourceReadDefinition).[`fieldAccess`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.ResourceReadDefinition#fieldaccess)

***

<a id="fielddependencies"></a>

### fieldDependencies?

> `optional` **fieldDependencies?**: `Readonly`\<`Record`\<`string`, (`identity`, `context`) => readonly ([`RelationshipRef`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.RelationshipRef) \| [`QueryDescriptor`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.QueryDescriptor)\<[`Values`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.TypeAlias.Values), `unknown`\>)[]\>\>

Pure prerequisites for derived fields. Reevaluate related queries as identity or relationship information arrives; derive publishes the resulting value.

***

#### Inherited from

### sources?

# Interface: ResourceReadDefinition

Generated from the public package entry points. Types and signatures follow the installed source.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.ResourceReadDefinition

[**Vem Data API**](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api)

***


Pure identity, scope, filter, and access rules shared by owner and tab. No transport or mutable owner state belongs here.

# Interface: RuntimeOptions

Generated from the public package entry points. Types and signatures follow the installed source.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.RuntimeOptions

[**Vem Data API**](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api)

***


Owner configuration with explicit concurrency, retention, hydration, recovery, access, and error reporting. Persistence is optional.

## Properties

<a id="access"></a>

### access?

> `optional` **access?**: readonly [`AccessDecision`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.AccessDecision)[]

***

<a id="checkpointtimeoutms"></a>

### checkpointTimeoutMs?

> `optional` **checkpointTimeoutMs?**: `number`

***

<a id="contextid"></a>

### contextId?

> `optional` **contextId?**: `string`

***

<a id="hydrationpagesize"></a>

### hydrationPageSize?

> `optional` **hydrationPageSize?**: `number`

***

<a id="maxacquisitionsperread"></a>

### maxAcquisitionsPerRead?

> `optional` **maxAcquisitionsPerRead?**: `number`

Bounds source dispatches for one finite read attempt. A partial result explains exhaustion; retry starts another attempt. Defaults to 4096.

***

<a id="maxconcurrent"></a>

### maxConcurrent?

> `optional` **maxConcurrent?**: `number`

Optional host cap on concurrent acquisitions; omitted by default so browser transport controls concurrency.

***

<a id="maxconcurrentactions"></a>

### maxConcurrentActions?

> `optional` **maxConcurrentActions?**: `number`

Maximum concurrent command executions; defaults to 4.

***

<a id="maxinactivequeries"></a>

### maxInactiveQueries?

> `optional` **maxInactiveQueries?**: `number`

Maximum retained inactive queries; defaults to 100.

***

<a id="maxinactiverecords"></a>

### maxInactiveRecords?

> `optional` **maxInactiveRecords?**: `number`

Maximum retained inactive records; defaults to 10000.

***

<a id="maxpendingactions"></a>

### maxPendingActions?

> `optional` **maxPendingActions?**: `number`

***

<a id="maxsettledactions"></a>

### maxSettledActions?

> `optional` **maxSettledActions?**: `number`

Maximum retained settled actions; defaults to 200.

***

<a id="maxunresolvedactions"></a>

### maxUnresolvedActions?

> `optional` **maxUnresolvedActions?**: `number`

***

<a id="persistence"></a>

### persistence?

> `optional` **persistence?**: [`PersistenceAdapter`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.PersistenceAdapter)

***

<a id="resources"></a>

### resources

> **resources**: readonly [`ResourceDefinition`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.ResourceDefinition)[]

***

<a id="transferfetch"></a>

### transferFetch?

> `optional` **transferFetch?**: \{(`input`, `init?`): `Promise`\<`Response`\>; (`input`, `init?`): `Promise`\<`Response`\>; \}

Fetch implementation for owner-bound transfers; defaults to global fetch.

#### Call Signature

> (`input`, `init?`): `Promise`\<`Response`\>

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Window/fetch)

##### Parameters

###### input

##### Returns

> (`input`, `init?`): `Promise`\<`Response`\>

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Window/fetch)

##### Parameters

###### input

`string` \| `Request` \| `URL`

###### init?

`RequestInit`

##### Returns

`Promise`\<`Response`\>

***

<a id="transfers"></a>

### transfers?

> `optional` **transfers?**: [`TransferExecutor`](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.TransferExecutor)

Optional browser-managed transfer executor; unsupported handoffs use owner-bound fetch.

## Methods

<a id="onerror"></a>

# Interface: TransferExecutor

Generated from the public package entry points. Types and signatures follow the installed source.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api/runtime.Interface.TransferExecutor

[**Vem Data API**](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api)

***


Optional host executor. Recover investigates the existing action ID and never starts a replacement transfer.

## Methods

### cancel()

> **cancel**(`id`): `Promise`\<`void`\>

#### Parameters

##### id

`string`

#### Returns

`Promise`\<`void`\>

***

#### Parameters

##### id

> `optional` **aria-checked?**: `boolean` \| `"true"` \| `"false"` \| `"mixed"`

#### See

 - aria-pressed
 - aria-selected.

<a id="nativebutton"></a>

### nativeButton?

> `optional` **nativeButton?**: `boolean`

Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

#### Default

```ts
true
```

# Interface: DataInspectorProps

Generated from the public package entry points. Types and signatures follow the installed source.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/devtools.Interface.DataInspectorProps

[**Vem UI API**](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api)

***


A development-only inspector. The application owns its clients, mode switches and lifetime.

## Properties

<a id="header"></a>

### header?

> `optional` **header?**: `ReactNode`

Application-specific connection information or mode controls.

***

<a id="inspection"></a>

### inspection

> **inspection**: `ClientInspector`

An existing inspector; mounting the view does not create data demand.

***

<a id="scenarios"></a>

### scenarios?

> `optional` **scenarios?**: `ScenarioClient`

Optional controls for an isolated scenario client matching the inspector.

### ref?

> `optional` **ref?**: `Ref`\<`HTMLElement`\>

Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

#### See

[React Docs](https://react.dev/learn/referencing-values-with-refs#refs-and-the-dom)

`ComponentProps.ref`

# Interface: VirtualListHandle

Generated from the public package entry points. Types and signatures follow the installed source.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/index.Interface.VirtualListHandle

[**Vem UI API**](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api)

***


Immediate, measurement-aware scrolling. Stable keys remain meaningful after filtering.

## Methods

<a id="scrolltoindex"></a>

### scrollToIndex()

> **scrollToIndex**(`index`, `align?`): `void`

#### Parameters

##### index

`number`

##### align?

`"center"` \| `"auto"` \| `"start"` \| `"end"`

#### Returns

`void`

***

<a id="scrolltokey"></a>

### scrollToKey()

> **scrollToKey**(`key`, `align?`): `void`

#### Parameters

##### key

`string` \| `number`

##### align?

`"center"` \| `"auto"` \| `"start"` \| `"end"`

#### Returns

`void`


---

# Interface: VirtualListItemState

Generated from the public package entry points. Types and signatures follow the installed source.

URL: https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api/index.Interface.VirtualListItemState

[**Vem UI API**](https://hyevem.com/docs/ui/reference/api)

***


Position and viewport visibility of one rendered row. Overscan does not make a row visible.

## Properties

<a id="overscan"></a>

### overscan?

> `optional` **overscan?**: `number`

Extra rendered rows on each side. Their visible state remains false. Defaults to 3.

<a id="ref"></a>

### ref?

> `optional` **ref?**: `Ref`\<`HTMLDivElement`\>

Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

#### See

[React Docs](https://react.dev/learn/referencing-values-with-refs#refs-and-the-dom)

#### Inherited from

`Omit.ref`

***
